conversationComments.author: poitee
conversationComments.body: The intended recovery behavior is settled. When the upload is confirmed but print start was interrupted, reconciliation must finish as uploaded-only. Starting the print requires a separate deliberate action. The prepared fix that requeues the pending start does not meet this requirement. The current implementation still needs the uploaded-only completion change, so the reconciliation review thread remains open.
